recipes.scope: Two servings. Uses two medium eggs (55 g edible each), one medium 65 g carrot, chopped spring onion and both listed oils. Pan oils are counted fully retained; salt is omitted because it contributes none of the displayed macros.
Two servings. Uses dry chickpea flour, 100 ml water for batter, one medium tomato and onion, 6 g fresh coriander, and listed pan oil counted fully retained.
Two servings. Uses dry semolina, plain 3.9% yogurt and 100 ml water for batter, one medium tomato and onion, and listed pan oil counted fully retained.
Two servings. Uses 100 g medium wheat flour and 60 ml tap water, spring onion, sesame oil, soy sauce, and all listed pan oil counted fully retained.

Two servings. Uses 100 g dry white long-grain rice, 150 g raw skinless chicken breast, ginger, spring onion and 700 ml water. Chicken is included at raw weight; cooking water is retained in the porridge.
Two servings. Uses 100 g dry white long-grain rice, 200 ml regular-fat canned coconut milk, two medium eggs (55 g edible each), and 100 g cucumber. All ingredients are counted as consumed.
Two servings. Uses 100 g medium wheat flour, 60 ml water for dough, 150 g peeled raw potato, 6 g fresh coriander, cumin, and all listed pan oil counted fully retained.

Two servings. Uses 150 g dried whole mung beans and 100 g dry white long-grain rice; both are specified dry weights before soaking. Green chilli and ginger are measured as listed; listed pan oil is counted fully retained.
Two servings. Uses 150 g dried broad beans, garlic, cumin, olive oil, and 700 ml water. Water is the chosen cooking liquid; salt is omitted as nutrient-free for the four displayed macros.
Two servings. Uses 100 g plain baguette, two medium eggs (55 g edible each), 100 g cucumber and 60 g peeled carrot. All listed pan oil is counted fully retained.
Two servings. Uses 100 g white rice flour, 200 ml regular-fat canned coconut milk, 150 g raw peeled shrimp and 150 g raw bean sprouts; listed pan oil is counted fully retained.
Two servings. Uses 100 g plain 3.9% yogurt, 200 ml prepared black coffee, one medium peeled banana (125 g edible mass), and 30 g regular sweetened condensed milk.
Two servings. Uses 100 g uncooked rolled oats, 15 g tahini, one tablespoon honey (20 g), 130 g peeled orange, and 700 ml water. Water replaces the original optional milk/water choice.
Two servings. Uses 100 g plain Greek yogurt at 7% fat, 30 g walnut kernels, one tablespoon honey (20 g), and 50 g fresh fig. It is served uncooked; salt is removed.
Two servings. Uses two medium eggs (55 g edible each), one medium tomato, 100 g raw mature spinach, 150 g feta at 25% fat, and listed pan oil counted fully retained.
Two servings. Uses two medium eggs (55 g edible each), one medium tomato and onion, 15 g fresh jalapeño (proxied with AFCD green chilli), and listed pan oil counted fully retained.

Two servings. Uses 100 g finely ground cornmeal, 200 ml whole milk and 700 ml water, plus one teaspoon cinnamon and vanilla extract. This resolves the optional milk-or-water ingredient as both specified milk and water in the recipe.

Two servings. Uses 150 g cooked drained corn kernels, two medium eggs (55 g edible each), 100 g medium wheat flour and Thai basil proxied with fresh sweet basil; all listed pan oil counted fully retained.
Two servings. Uses 200 g peeled raw mango, 100 g plain 3.9% yogurt, 15 g lime juice and 20 g unsweetened desiccated coconut. Served uncooked; salt is removed.

Two servings. Uses 100 g white rice flour with 250 ml water for steamed sheets, 100 g fresh button mushrooms, 150 g untrimmed raw pork mince, and one tablespoon commercial fish sauce. Fish sauce is counted in full; unquantified salt contributes no macros.
